_purpose: LNES-60 Phase 1 experiment freeze. Sealed before the first blind execution against the holdout. No tuning after this point based on holdout results.

P0.description: Documentary + command state only, NO physical witnesses.

P1.description: Documentary + command + RAW physical witnesses, ungoverned interpretation.

P2.description: Documentary + command + witnesses + witness trust -> deterministic witness validation -> deterministic convergence (FROZEN engine) -> model candidate -> simulated LNES-22 gate (FROZEN release_policy) -> authorized state. Both candidate and authorized decisions recorded.

generation_mechanism.detail: MODEL_SIMULATOR: RULE_BASED_REFERENCE, NOT AN LLM (lnes60/model_simulator.py). The Agent-tool subagent-dispatch mechanism used for LNES-59's real-model generation was already exhausted (200/200 spawned) earlier in this session; running the full 150-case x up-to-3-arm matrix via direct self-generation (the LNES-59 tail's fallback) was judged impractical at this scale within one continuous session. This is a disclosed scope reduction, not a hidden one -- per the directive's own explicit fallback instruction (Section 24): use deterministic simulator-only testing for state-engine components, clearly separated from a MODEL-IN-THE-LOOP result, and do not fabricate model results. No real-model (LLM) generation occurs anywhere in this experiment's P0/P1/P2 arms.

retry_policy.retryable: infrastructure/execution failures only (e.g. malformed case data, script crash)
retry_policy.not_retryable: a semantically-wrong operational_state or release_recommendation is never retried -- it is a result
